## Hypothesis

The SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK_REFINEMENT candidate aims to refine the SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK trade class by incorporating a VIX-trend regime filter. The hypothesis is that this refinement will improve the edge capture and stability of the trade class.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves adding a VIX-trend regime filter to the existing SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK trade class. The filter will be based on the VIX 5-day average and will only allow trades when the VIX is in an escalating trend.
